paper_cards.title: RobotAgentBench: Towards Open-world Robot Autonomy
paper_cards.data: 50 household layouts; 90 atomic, 18 short, 8 long and 4 open-ended scenarios; versioned assets and 1,470 saved configurations.
paper_cards.method: Agent-assisted human-in-the-loop real-to-sim construction plus a planning-execution-verification runtime with task-specific process scoring.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate task discovery, context reasoning, manipulation, recovery, robustness and open-ended household autonomy.
paper_cards.novelty: Unifies capability-level and scenario-level open-world robot-agent evaluation under a released physical execution interface.
paper_cards.evidence: Official repository releases task backends, initialization, scoring, runtime, hashed assets and saved configurations.

claim_checks.claim: The released benchmark covers 50 layouts and six evaluation dimensions with executable task-specific scoring.
claim_checks.notes: Official repository and documentation inspected; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Isaac Sim and GPU setup are substantial; paper results were not independently reproduced.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct benchmark/runtime interface for evaluating generated household worlds and agent recovery beyond fixed task execution.

paper_cards.title: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
paper_cards.data: 30 quantitative experiments in five disciplines on 14 apparatus platforms with resampled hidden parameters.
paper_cards.method: Physics-based laboratory tasks score both grounded measurement conclusions and required physical state changes.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate whether an embodied agent can design and execute experiments to discover an initially unknown quantity.
paper_cards.novelty: Bridges manipulation and scientific discovery by making physical intervention and instrument reading necessary for knowing.
paper_cards.evidence: Official code and benchmark define solvable experiments and compare six frontier coding agents under multiple tool conditions.

claim_checks.claim: The benchmark contains 30 experiments across five disciplines and releases its evaluation code.
claim_checks.notes: Official repository and linked official demo inspected.

paper_cards.limitations: Simulation-only; real laboratory transfer and independent reproduction remain unverified.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct closed-loop validator for intervention, observation, state tracking and evidence-grounded conclusions in executable worlds.

paper_cards.title: Embodied Playground: A Long-Horizon Agentic Robotics Benchmark for Physical, Strategic, and Spatial Reasoning
paper_cards.data: 410 task environments, EP-100 curated tasks, five suites, 16 task types, EP-Easy/Hard and EP-20 subsets.
paper_cards.method: A shared robot-agent interface with observation/tool budgets and independent goal, rule-compliance and physical-validity checks.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate sustained physical, strategic and spatial reasoning over interdependent long-horizon robot tasks.
paper_cards.novelty: Combines a broad environment catalog with explicit rule and physical validity evaluation rather than endpoint-only success.
paper_cards.evidence: Official project publishes code, machine-readable task/results indexes and provenance for reference execution media.

claim_checks.claim: The official release exposes 410 environments and independent goal, rule and physical-validity checks.
claim_checks.notes: Official project, code links, indexes and demo provenance inspected.

paper_cards.limitations: Inspected videos are reference executions, not external-agent scores; broad cross-suite comparisons remain author-reported.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct long-horizon evaluation harness for generated interactive scenes, task rules and physical validity.

demo_cards.demo_notes: Official evaluator, assets, model example and multiple task videos are public.
Official code and 2:50 demo are public.
Official code, task indexes and provenance-linked videos are public.
